english.meaning: the dark part of the day; also counts nights
english.note: 三日兩夜 means three days and two nights.

exampleSentences.english: So, there was a vineyard to see, but we’d taken overnight rides two nights in a row before that, so... how should I put it?
exampleSentences.traditional: 噉，嗰度就葡萄園囖去睇，但係因為之前我哋，誒，坐過兩晚夜車啊連續，所以呢，即係點啊？

exampleSentences.english: Yeah. Just don’t ask them out at midnight. Ask me out after midnight.
